summary.name: Bigan (笔杆)
summary.one_liner: Bigan (笔杆) is a Chinese academic writing platform offering thesis samples, format templates, plagiarism checking, AIGC (AI-generated text) detection, topic selection, and reference tools.
use_cases: checking a graduation thesis for duplicate text
detecting AI-generated passages in a paper
choosing a research or thesis topic
writing a proposal or literature review
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a suite of tools for academic writing in Chinese. Plagiarism checking (论文查重) returns a report in seconds, claims a database of 120 billion fingerprint records, and says uploaded text is converted to encrypted fingerprints. AIGC detection estimates the share of text likely generated by models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, 文心一言, 智谱AI and 通义千问, showing overall suspicion rates and per-sentence probabilities. Topic analysis draws on a claimed 30 million-topic library and academic hot-spot tracking. A reference tool checks and tunes bibliographies in one click.
notable: Claims 120 billion plagiarism fingerprint records and second-level report times
AIGC detection covering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and several Chinese LLMs with per-sentence probabilities
Topic selection tool drawing on a claimed 30 million academic journal and thesis database
Self-service checks that leave no trace, with a private comparison library option
caveats: The page does not state which features are free and which are paid, so pricing is only listed as freemium from the directory listing
AIGC results are probabilities and, per the page, do not reflect paper quality
The page is mostly marketing copy in Chinese and makes unverified claims about data volume
